description: Source code for a shell command interface in the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform, providing command registration, execution, and a main loop for user interaction.

methods.name: SHELL_Init
methods.description: Initializes the shell command system and registers the help command.

methods.name: SHELL_AddCmd
methods.description: Adds a new command to the shell command list.

methods.name: SHELL_RunCmd
methods.description: Parses and executes a command string entered by the user.

methods.name: SHELL_Mainloop
methods.description: Runs the main loop for the shell, handling user input and command execution.
